### findings
Charter-global REDs (each lists every member found in one pass). "Bears on" names the task trees whose policies carry the member; the numeric consequence on each world is demonstrated in that task's file.

- **R1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF A2): every assembly sentence names each factor's quantity.** Members (rule sentences, also quoted in each `result`/`visit_hours`/`net_scope`/`carrier_payable` basis): presample "the sampling line amount is the standard-set charge they set, plus every era-material charge, turnaround charge, documentation charge and handling charge they set, less any collection credit"; workplan "the visit hours are the walk hours they set plus every claim-coordination, regulated-material, moisture-verification, work-plan lead-time and overhead-survey addition they set"; deposit "first the coverage credit they set is subtracted … then the notice raise, the lead-safe prepayment, the contamination raise and the protocol contingency they set …"; disposal "the loads they set times the per-load fee they set, plus the trip charge and the wet-debris charge they set"; share "the mold-covered total less the ordinance-or-law carve-out … capped at the coverage allowance, plus the ordinance-or-law carve-out; … less the program and assignment write-down, less the after-hours write-down". Consequence: the sentence the KB must carry once for each policy enumerates every factor's quantity, so the rendered assembly text references every factor document and lists the factor set without any record being read — the published-KB requirement that each factor document is findable from the records and referenced by nothing cannot be met by any rendering of these sentences. Bears on: task 0 (presample, workplan, deposit), task 1 (disposal, share).
- **R2 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF C1, undeclared override): presample and work-plan lines contradict base mold_tier_and_funding "A company_warranty job is performed at no charge: no charge line of any kind is booked on it".** Members: presample "is booked once per job as one line …" for every job "in a building built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff"; workplan "Every job on a tier that requires a protocol carries one work-plan visit line"; and the deposit's two prerequisite sentences, which call both lines "owed" on any pre-1981 / protocol-tier job. No overwrite names the base sentence (mold_tier_and_funding is not even in base_policy_refs). Second reading, producible world: a company_warranty Limited job (protocol required) — base: no line; extended: a work-plan line of at least 2.0 h × 102.80 = 205.60. Bears on: task 0's tree (structurally; task 0's job is insurance_claim, so no numeric consequence on its world).
- **R3 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF C1, anonymous intermediate): insured share's coverage allowance is the whole mold sublimit, against base mold_agg_shared_sublimit (a base_policy_ref, `overwrite: []`)** "insurance proceeds posted to all mold jobs linked to the same claim file together may never exceed the claim file's mold sublimit … Charges above what the sublimit covers stay owed by the customer on the job." Members: allowance tier 1 "equal to the claim file's mold sublimit" and tier 2 "the lesser of that mold sublimit and the claim file's submitted estimate amount" — neither nets proceeds already posted to other mold jobs of the claim. Second reading, producible world: sublimit 5,000.00 with 3,000.00 already posted to another mold job of the same claim file — base leaves this job's sublimit cover at 2,000.00, extended allows 5,000.00, so the share differs by up to 3,000.00. (The deposit's coverage credit "equal to that mold sublimit" has the same shape but the deposit does not cite the shared-sublimit policy — observation O9.) Bears on: task 1's tree (no second mold job on task 1's claim — no numeric consequence on its world).
- **R4 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF A7, mislabelled method pair): workplan protocol_review tier 1 "the larger of the base visit hours and the re-survey hours" is max(2.0, 4.0) ≡ 4.0 hours on its whole domain**, so T1 vs T3 (2.0 hours) differ only by a number; the label `method` is dishonest for that pair and the work-plan computation keeps no factor that passes the method test (method floor 1 → 0). Bears on: task 0.
- **R5 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (mislabelled effect): share program_writedown is labelled `parameter` but tier 1 (program pricing discount % × mold-covered total + carrier_denied_line write-offs) and tier 2 (the write-offs alone) differ by an added input and two operations** — a change of formula shape, which is a `method` tier by A7. Bears on: task 1.
- **R6 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (E1/E4 realism, unreal tier value): program_writedown subtracts the program discount and the claim file's carrier_denied_line write-offs from a share whose carrier-payable amount is already the undiscounted, undenied mold-covered total whenever the coverage allowance does not bind.** Producible world: Carrier Program job, charges 4,000.00 all mold-covered plus a 50.00 late fee, sublimit 5,000.00, no carve, no payments: carrier-payable 4,000.00, write-down 260.00 → share max(0, 4,050.00 − 4,000.00 − 260.00) = 0.00, so the customer is relieved of the 50.00 non-covered fee by a discount the carrier program applies to its own payment; a real program bills the customer charge total − covered = 50.00. The write-offs are also claim-file-wide (a denied water-job line reduces the mold share). Bears on: task 1's tree (task 1's allowance binds — see task file).
- **R7 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (unreal ladder / self-contradiction): share after_hours_writedown tier 2 writes down the supervisor after-hours premium only "when it carries no such technician lines".** The schedule's own premise "on a claim file whose arrangement never bills declined lines to the customer, the after-hours premium the carrier declines is written down" and claims_evt_writeoff ("on Assignment of Benefits and Carrier Program files it is never billed to the customer") cover every declined after-hours premium; a job with both technician and supervisor after-hours lines keeps the supervisor premium billed to the customer — no arrangement that never bills declined lines publishes that. Bears on: task 1's tree (task 1 has no after-hours supervisor lines).
- **R8 — SOURCE-TASK RED (XF A9, two groupings): share after-hours sentence "their amount times the after-hours labor multiplier less 1, divided by that multiplier"** reads as amount × (m − 1) / m or as (amount × m − 1) / m. Bears on: task 1 (two values demonstrated there).
- **R9 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (unreal ladder, scope restatement): presample building_age_set tier 2 "growth in an attic or crawlspace of a building whose age is at least the insulation-era age (45)".** The policy's scope is a building built before 1981; for any opening date on or after 2025-01-01 every such building is at least 45 whole years old (1980-01-01 → 2025-01-01 = 540 months), so the age part holds of every customer who reaches this write and the tier reduces to "attic or crawlspace growth". Bears on: task 0's tree (task 0 takes tier 1).

(b) Both schedules read the water job's status / lines with no anchor date although the line is dated the job's opened date and booked later ("a linked company water job in dispatched, authorized or drying status"; "booked a lead-safe setup line"): the status on the opened date is reconstructable from drying_start_date / drying_complete_date and line service dates and can differ from the status when booked. Producible world: building built 1970, living area, linked category_1 / class_1 water job in drying with an asbestos line within 365 days, lead time over 5 days, self-pay: 0.00 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 − 75.00 = −75.00 (and 0.00 when that water job is drying_complete). ### re-derived (revision_4)
- **S3 closed.** New share sentence: "On a claim file whose arrangement never bills declined lines to the customer, when a water mitigation job or reconstruction contract linked to the same claim file carries a billing error, duplicate line or goodwill credit or a change order credit, a carrier_denied_line write-off on the file may record value that job already credited rather than a line the carrier declined, and the request is likewise handed to a human representative as not covered by policy."
